messages:
anya: RFC follow-up: propose "fenceout" for session-manager+kv. run a compatibility shim so runtime calls unchanged. goals: independent deploys, clearer ownership, and a tech-debt paydown window. ask: risks and must-haves.

devon: main risk is latency tail. need inproc-like fast-path (unix socket) and perf gate.

misha: need contract tests + dual-read migration plan. dual-read doubles read load.

liz: ops needs per-tenant latency histograms, canary flags, kill-switch runbook, and a perf-regression blocker.

anya: plan: prototype modes (inproc shim, local-socket fast-path, grpc fallback). migration: 4-week dual-read/backfill. rollout: staging stress -> 1% canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 4 weeks. perf gate: p95 <= baseline *1.15 else halt.

infra-bot: created INFRA-1509: "fenceout shim + telemetry" (assign: devops).

devon: add chaos test (shim kill) and scheduled rollback drill.

misha: flag heavy-embedding tenants for cost impact during backfill.

anya: will add acceptance criteria: CI contract tests, telemetry dashboards, perf gate, runbook. scheduling short sync with infra on Monday. :thumbsup:
